source: Calibrate intensities across imaging sessions before measuring: each plate is one session, the beads or reference wells imaged on every plate are measured, and every plate's intensity channels are scaled so its reference wells match the selected reference plate's; a blank reference plate setting uses the first plate by name. This corrects exposure, lamp and detector drift between days at the image level, unlike batch correction of tables. The gains are recorded in measurements.db:intensity_rescale. Default False.

de.source: Calibrate intensities across imaging sessions before measuring: each plate is one session, the beads or reference wells imaged on every plate are measured, and every plate's intensity channels are scaled so its reference wells match the selected reference plate's; a blank reference plate setting uses the first plate by name. This corrects exposure, lamp and detector drift between days at the image level, unlike batch correction of tables. The gains are recorded in measurements.db:intensity_rescale. Default False.
de.translation: Kalibriert Intensitäten über Bildgebungssitzungen hinweg vor der Messung: Jede Platte ist eine Sitzung, die auf jeder Platte aufgenommenen Beads oder Referenz-Wells werden gemessen, und die Intensitätskanäle jeder Platte werden so skaliert, dass ihre Referenz-Wells denen der gewählten Referenzplatte entsprechen; bei leerer Referenzplatten-Einstellung wird die erste Platte nach Namen verwendet. Das korrigiert Belichtungs-, Lampen- und Detektordrift zwischen Tagen auf Bildebene, anders als eine Batch-Korrektur von Tabellen. Die Faktoren werden in measurements.db:intensity_rescale gespeichert. Standard False.

es.source: Calibrate intensities across imaging sessions before measuring: each plate is one session, the beads or reference wells imaged on every plate are measured, and every plate's intensity channels are scaled so its reference wells match the selected reference plate's; a blank reference plate setting uses the first plate by name. This corrects exposure, lamp and detector drift between days at the image level, unlike batch correction of tables. The gains are recorded in measurements.db:intensity_rescale. Default False.
es.translation: Calibra intensidades entre sesiones de adquisición antes de medir: cada placa es una sesión, se miden las microesferas o pocillos de referencia fotografiados en cada placa, y los canales de intensidad de cada placa se escalan para que sus pocillos de referencia coincidan con los de la placa de referencia seleccionada; si el ajuste de placa de referencia está vacío, se usa la primera placa por nombre. Esto corrige la deriva de exposición, lámpara y detector entre días a nivel de imagen, a diferencia de la corrección de lotes de las tablas. Las ganancias se registran en measurements.db:intensity_rescale. Valor predeterminado: False.

fr.source: Calibrate intensities across imaging sessions before measuring: each plate is one session, the beads or reference wells imaged on every plate are measured, and every plate's intensity channels are scaled so its reference wells match the selected reference plate's; a blank reference plate setting uses the first plate by name. This corrects exposure, lamp and detector drift between days at the image level, unlike batch correction of tables. The gains are recorded in measurements.db:intensity_rescale. Default False.
fr.translation: Calibre les intensités entre sessions d’imagerie avant la mesure : chaque plaque est une session, les billes ou puits de référence imagés sur chaque plaque sont mesurés, et les canaux d’intensité de chaque plaque sont mis à l’échelle pour que ses puits de référence correspondent à ceux de la plaque de référence sélectionnée ; si le réglage de plaque de référence est vide, la première plaque par nom est utilisée. Cela corrige la dérive d’exposition, de lampe et de détecteur d’un jour à l’autre au niveau de l’image, contrairement à une correction de lot des tables. Les gains sont enregistrés dans measurements.db:intensity_rescale. Valeur par défaut : False.

hi.translation: मापन से पहले इमेजिंग सत्रों के बीच तीव्रताओं का अंशांकन करें: हर प्लेट एक सत्र है, हर प्लेट पर इमेज किए गए बीड या संदर्भ वेल मापे जाते हैं, और हर प्लेट के तीव्रता चैनल इस तरह स्केल होते हैं कि उसके संदर्भ वेल चुनी गई संदर्भ प्लेट से मेल खाएँ; संदर्भ प्लेट की सेटिंग खाली होने पर नाम के क्रम में पहली प्लेट का उपयोग होता है। यह तालिकाओं के बैच सुधार के विपरीत, छवि स्तर पर दिनों के बीच एक्सपोज़र, लैंप और डिटेक्टर के विचलन को सुधारता है। गेन measurements.db:intensity_rescale में दर्ज होते हैं। डिफ़ॉल्ट False।

is.source: Calibrate intensities across imaging sessions before measuring: each plate is one session, the beads or reference wells imaged on every plate are measured, and every plate's intensity channels are scaled so its reference wells match the selected reference plate's; a blank reference plate setting uses the first plate by name. is.translation: Kvarðar styrk milli myndatökulota fyrir mælingu: hver plata er ein lota, perlurnar eða viðmiðunarbrunnarnir sem myndaðir eru á hverri plötu eru mældir, og styrkrásir hverrar plötu eru kvarðaðar svo viðmiðunarbrunnar hennar passi við þá á valinni viðmiðunarplötu; ef stillingin fyrir viðmiðunarplötu er auð er fyrsta platan eftir nafni notuð. Þetta leiðréttir rek í lýsingu, lampa og skynjara milli daga á myndstigi, ólíkt lotuleiðréttingu taflna. Magnanirnar eru skráðar í measurements.db:intensity_rescale. Sjálfgefið False.

ko.translation: 측정 전에 촬영 세션 간 강도를 보정합니다. 각 플레이트가 한 세션이며, 모든 플레이트에서 촬영한 비드나 기준 웰을 측정하고, 기준 웰이 선택한 기준 플레이트와 같아지도록 각 플레이트의 강도 채널을 조정합니다. 기준 플레이트 설정이 비어 있으면 이름순으로 첫 번째 플레이트를 사용합니다. 표의 배치 보정과 달리 이미지 수준에서 날짜 간 노출, 광원, 검출기 드리프트를 보정합니다. 이득은 measurements.db:intensity_rescale에 기록됩니다. 기본값 False.

pt.source: Calibrate intensities across imaging sessions before measuring: each plate is one session, the beads or reference wells imaged on every plate are measured, and every plate's intensity channels are scaled so its reference wells match the selected reference plate's; a blank reference plate setting uses the first plate by name. This corrects exposure, lamp and detector drift between days at the image level, unlike batch correction of tables. The gains are recorded in measurements.db:intensity_rescale. Default False.
pt.translation: Calibra intensidades entre sessões de aquisição antes da medição: cada placa é uma sessão, as microesferas ou poços de referência imageados em cada placa são medidos, e os canais de intensidade de cada placa são escalados para que seus poços de referência coincidam com os da placa de referência selecionada; se a configuração da placa de referência estiver vazia, usa-se a primeira placa por nome. Isso corrige a deriva de exposição, lâmpada e detector entre dias no nível da imagem, ao contrário da correção de lote de tabelas. Os ganhos são registrados em measurements.db:intensity_rescale. Padrão False.

sv.source: Calibrate intensities across imaging sessions before measuring: each plate is one session, the beads or reference wells imaged on every plate are measured, and every plate's intensity channels are scaled so its reference wells match the selected reference plate's; a blank reference plate setting uses the first plate by name. sv.translation: Kalibrerar intensiteter mellan avbildningssessioner före mätningen: varje platta är en session, de pärlor eller referensbrunnar som avbildats på varje platta mäts, och varje plattas intensitetskanaler skalas så att dess referensbrunnar matchar den valda referensplattans; om inställningen för referensplatta är tom används den första plattan efter namn. Detta korrigerar exponerings-, lamp- och detektordrift mellan dagar på bildnivå, till skillnad från batchkorrigering av tabeller. Förstärkningarna sparas i measurements.db:intensity_rescale. Standard False.

zh_CN.translation: 测量前在成像会话之间校准强度：每块板为一个会话，测量每块板上成像的微球或参照孔，并缩放每块板的强度通道，使其参照孔与所选参照板一致；参照板设置为空时，使用按名称排序的第一块板。这会在图像层面校正不同日期之间的曝光、光源和检测器漂移，不同于对表格进行批次校正。增益记录在 measurements.db:intensity_rescale 中。默认值 False。
